Fubrus’s budget is **$400K**.

I counted only Finance Office budget updates, resolving withdrawals of withdrawals before summing. Non-Finance messages and administrative notices have no budget effect.

The following checkpoints apply the updates that remain effective **at the end of all records**:

| Records processed | Budget subtotal |
|---|---:|
| #0001–#0400 | $2,241K |
| #0401–#0800 | $1,772K |
| #0801–#1200 | $1,765K |
| #1201–#1600 | $400K |

For example, the withdrawal chain ultimately restores #0009’s $462K decrease, while #1591 cancels #1555’s $321K decrease. Each surviving update is counted once.

ANSWER: $400K
